prerequisites: Mathematics II (Systems of linear equations, Regression and correlation in two variables)

learning_outcomes.text: Know and apply the concepts of dynamic calculation and modal analysis, and design machines taking into account vibrational and acoustic aspects and design corrective measures for vibrations and noise.

syllabus_topics: Chapter I.- Balancing of Rotating and Reciprocating Machines.
3.- Balancing of reciprocating masses: Crank-rod mechanism.
Chapter II.- Systems with One and Several Degrees of Freedom.
5.- Vibrations in systems with one DOF.
8.- Fourier analysis and frequency domain response.
Chapter III.- Theory of Modal Analysis.
Chapter IV.- Dynamic Calculation by Computer.
12.- Solution of the problem by finite elements.
14.- Response of a building to seismic action.
assessment_rules: 50% of the written exams must be passed. If this critical evaluation criterion is not met, the total grade for the course will be FAIL, with the sum of all evaluation scores truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points. Once the written exams are passed, the scores obtained will be weighted according to the established proportions. Written exams are recoverable.
